motivation.text: Nothing changes until you move. One small step is enough to begin.

discipline.text: Your habits are always watching. Make them proud when nobody else is looking.

money.text: True wealth is built in the quiet moments when you choose patience over applause.

mindset.text: My first thought is a draft, not the final version of this day.

fact.text: Some whales can live for over two centuries, carrying harpoons from the 1800s in their blubber.

books.text: Your mind runs on fast intuition and slow reasoning; pause to engage the slower system when stakes rise.
books.credit: Idea from Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman

stoic.text: We are not short on time; we are careless with the hours we already have.
